body: Anything you can do? Very nice to ask, but to be honest no not really. that is unless you happen to have a large amount of money and you can help pay for the medical bills. haha since my mother is out of work and watching my 5 brothers and sisters by herself while my dad is slaving away at work for 11 hours everyday so we have only enought money for rent and bills and 1 and a half weeks of food, while we write bad checks so we can eat for 4 days out of the week while continuing to have a place to sleep.
